say:2:1810540101:1.text: Baba, it's bad! We were ambushed by Bantus soldiers right outside the village. A few of them got away to report back!
say:2:1810540101:1.source_cn: 婆婆，不好了！我们刚出村子就遇到了埋伏的班题斯士兵，有...

say:3:1810540102:1.text: Those rotten lapdogs... They're already this close?!
say:3:1810540102:1.source_cn: ——刚出村子就遇到？！这群狗腿子……竟敢离得这么近！

say:6:1810540103:0.text: They must have realized something's wrong with the treant. They'll be attacking soon. We need to prepare for a fight.
say:6:1810540103:0.source_cn: 他们肯定已经发现了希尔达的异常，很快就会攻入夕染村，我...

choice_prompt:7:1810540103.text: They must have realized something's wrong with the treant. They'll be attacking soon. We need to prepare for a fight.
choice_prompt:7:1810540103.source_cn: 他们肯定已经发现了希尔达的异常，很快就会攻入夕染村，我们必须做好战斗准备。

say:8:1810540106:0.text: Thane, you have more experience fighting Bantus soldiers than any of us. What do you think?
say:8:1810540106:0.source_cn: 瑟恩，你对付班题斯士兵的经验比我多，你有什么建议？

say:9:1810540107:1.text: Most Graveborn have more fragile bodies than the living. Their movement and reflexes are slower than a normal human's.
say:9:1810540107:1.source_cn: 绝大部分亡灵的肉体都远比生者脆弱，行动力和反应力都不及...

say:10:1810540108:1.text: We used to set up <style="highlight">rolling logs</style> and take advantage of the terrain to wipe out the weaker ones first, then deal with the rest.

say:11:1810540109:1.text: I noticed a steep slope north of the village earlier. We could set it up there.
say:11:1810540109:1.source_cn: 我玩捉迷藏的时候有观察过，村子北面有一处滑坡，可以在那...

say:14:1810540110:1.text: Right! That's where <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were ambushed. The terrain there is really steep.
say:14:1810540110:1.male: Right! That's where <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were ambushed. The terrain there is really steep.
say:14:1810540110:1.female: Right! That's where <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were ambushed. The terrain there is really steep.

say:15:1810540111:1.text: Then we <style="highlight">barricade every other entrance to the village</style>, and force them to advance through that slope.
say:15:1810540111:1.source_cn: 那就<style=highlight>把其他方向连通村...

say:16:1810540112:1.text: Once they're in position, we release the logs. It won't take them all out, but it should thin their numbers.
say:16:1810540112:1.source_cn: 然后看准时机，把滚木放下去。虽然不能消灭所有敌人，但也...

say:17:1810540113:1.text: But... what if they manage to dodge them?
say:17:1810540113:1.source_cn: 如果……我是说如果，他们成功避开了滚木呢？

say:18:1810540114:1.text: I'll hold them off. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> retreat to the Bone Hut and look for a way out.
say:18:1810540114:1.male: I'll hold them off. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> retreat to the Bone Hut and look for a way out.
say:18:1810540114:1.female: I'll hold them off. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> retreat to the Bone Hut and look for a way out.

say:19:1810540115:1.text: That's too dangerous! You only have one arm, you're already at a disadvantage. Let me help.
say:19:1810540115:1.source_cn: 那也太危险了！你只有一条手臂，本来就有劣势，我也来帮忙吧。

say:20:1810540116:0.text: No. You stay with Baba Muriel and protect her. They're after the two of you. She knows the area, but she might not be able to outrun the soldiers.
say:20:1810540116:0.source_cn: 你留在穆婆婆身边保护她。敌人的目标是你们两个，她熟悉环...

say:24:1810540118:0.text: I'm fighting with you. I've recovered enough.
say:24:1810540118:0.source_cn: 瑟恩，我要和你一起战斗，我的身体已经没有大碍了。

say:25:1810540119:1.text: That assassin we ran into before entering the village is bound to show up again. I'll handle her.
say:25:1810540119:1.source_cn: 进入夕染村之前遇到的那个杀手，她肯定会再度出现，我来对付她。

say:26:1810540120:1.text: She's an assassin, Estrilda. She's not like the soldiers you've fought before.
say:26:1810540120:1.source_cn: 她是刺客，和你之前交战的班题斯士兵不同。

choice_prompt:27:1810540121.text: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
choice_prompt:27:1810540121.source_cn: 你看，<style=stress><player_name></style>都这么说了。放心吧瑟恩，上次交手时，我已经摸清她的实力。
choice_prompt:27:1810540121.male: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
choice_prompt:27:1810540121.female: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.

say:28:1810540121:0.text: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
say:28:1810540121:0.male: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
say:28:1810540121:0.female: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.

say:29:1810540122:1.text: ... I trust you. Let's go <style="highlight">prepare the rolling logs</style>. The more, the better.
say:29:1810540122:1.source_cn: 好，我相信你。走吧，我们去<style=highlig...

say:32:1810540123:0.text: And Baba Muriel... Keep trying to treat Hilda. If she wakes up, it'll help us a lot.
say:32:1810540123:0.source_cn: ……至于穆婆婆，继续尝试治疗希尔达。若她能够恢复，就对...

say:33:1810540124:0.text: Hmph! Since you've finally said something sensible for once, I suppose I'll listen to you.
say:33:1810540124:0.source_cn: 哼，看在你难得说了句人话的份上，老身就姑且听你一回。

choice:27:0:1.text: Don't worry, she's not that tough.
choice:27:0:1.male: Don't worry, she's not that tough.
choice:27:0:1.female: Don't worry, she's not that tough.

choice:27:1:2.text: Estrilda's fast enough to handle her!
choice:27:1:2.male: Estrilda's fast enough to handle her!
choice:27:1:2.female: Estrilda's fast enough to handle her!

choice:7:0:1.text: Rain and I thought the same.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 我和里纳也是这么推测的
choice:7:0:1.male: Rain and I thought the same.
choice:7:0:1.female: Rain and I thought the same.

say:35:1810540104:0.text: With the meager magic you brats have? Not a chance.
say:35:1810540104:0.source_cn: 就凭老身和你们这点魔力，没有别的办法。

say:36:1810540105:0.text: If we want to stop them, we'll have to do it another way.
say:36:1810540105:0.source_cn: 想要拦住他们，只能从其他地方下功夫。

choice:7:1:2.text: Is there any other way to help Hilda recover?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 还有没有其他办法能帮希尔达恢复？
choice:7:1:2.male: Is there any other way to help Hilda recover?
choice:7:1:2.female: Is there any other way to help Hilda recover?
